# Mouse and trackpad fixes in the song library and the settings (fix/mouse165), with the demo's made-up library.
# Minecraft 1.21.11, 1280x720 (the default size), GUI scale 3 = 427x240; the mouse rests in the middle of the window.
# Run it on the branch, and with -f mod_ref=main for the old code, and compare each shot:
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/mouse165 -f version=1.21.11 -f script=.github/checks/mouse165.txt
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/mouse165 -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=main -f script=.github/checks/mouse165.txt
# Lines next to each other run in the same tick: eight "scroll -0.25" are one trackpad swipe of two notches' worth, two
# "click" lines are a double-click. "scroll -1 0" is a sideways scroll to the right (1.21.11 gives left as above 0).
#
# - mouse165-carousel-start: the carousel on Liked songs, the first song in the middle. The same on both.
# - mouse165-carousel-trackpad: after the small-steps swipe. Branch: the THIRD song in the middle (two notches' worth,
#   two covers). Main: the NINTH song (one cover for each small step, eight).
# - mouse165-carousel-sideways: after three sideways scrolls to the right. Branch: three covers on, the SIXTH song in the
#   middle. Main: nothing moved, still the ninth.
# - mouse165-shelf-hover: the shelf on Liked songs, the mouse on the third cover, its name under the shelf. The same on both.
# - mouse165-shelf-wheel: the wheel slid the shelf one cover left under the still mouse. Branch: the cover now under the
#   mouse (the fourth) is the lifted one with ITS name under the shelf. Main: the third song's name stays, and two covers
#   are lifted (the third, which slid left, and the fourth under the mouse, which a click would play).
# - mouse165-shelf-sideways: after three sideways scrolls to the right. Branch: the shelf slid one more cover left, the
#   fifth cover under the mouse and named. Main: the shelf didn't move (the same picture as mouse165-shelf-wheel).
# - mouse165-playlist-open: the playlist "Late-night building" open, "‹ Playlists" at the top left. The same on both.
# - mouse165-back-double-click: after a double-click on "‹ Playlists". Branch: the Playlists grid. Main: the Search
#   section (its tab highlighted, the search box waiting for typing), where the second click landed.
# - mouse165-reset-before: the settings' Lyrics tab with Layout on Lines, the footer's "Reset all". The same on both.
# - mouse165-reset-double-click: after a double-click on Reset all. Branch: the button reads "Click again to reset" and
#   Layout is still Lines. Main: every setting was reset at once: Layout is back on World and the button reads "Reset all".
# Not in the pictures: on a Mac, Ctrl+click no longer acts as a left click (it needs a real Mac and mouse button; unit tested).

cmd weather clear
cmd time set noon
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
look 0 -20
sleep 6
guiscale 3

set libraryView CAROUSEL
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.LibraryScreen
sleep 4
shot mouse165-carousel-start
scroll -0.25
scroll -0.25
scroll -0.25
scroll -0.25
scroll -0.25
scroll -0.25
scroll -0.25
scroll -0.25
sleep 2
shot mouse165-carousel-trackpad
scroll -1 0
scroll -1 0
scroll -1 0
sleep 2
shot mouse165-carousel-sideways
close
sleep 1

set libraryView SHELF
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.LibraryScreen
sleep 4
hover 213 120
sleep 1
shot mouse165-shelf-hover
scroll -3
sleep 2
shot mouse165-shelf-wheel
scroll -1 0
scroll -1 0
scroll -1 0
sleep 2
shot mouse165-shelf-sideways
close
sleep 1

set libraryView GRID
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.LibraryScreen
sleep 4
# Liked songs -> Playlists, the first playlist, open it (as lib113)
key tab
sleep 1
key right
sleep 0.5
key enter
sleep 2
shot mouse165-playlist-open
click 30 46
click 30 46
sleep 2
shot mouse165-back-double-click
close
sleep 1

set layout LINES
gui 0
sleep 3
shot mouse165-reset-before
click 124 215
click 124 215
sleep 1
shot mouse165-reset-double-click
# Main's reset turned the demo song off: the test game keeps it
set demoMode true
set layout WORLD
close
guiscale 0
